abilities.name: Hull Knock
abilities.description: Knock on a bulkhead and hear whether there is air, vacuum or something alive on the other side.
abilities.cost: Anything alive hears the knock too

growth.grows: how thick a wall and how much you can tell

abilities.name: Zero-G Ease
abilities.description: You can move in zero gravity as smoothly as walking, pushing off exactly where you mean to go.
abilities.cost: Queasy for an hour after you return to gravity

abilities.name: Derelict Read
abilities.description: Read a dead ship's damage and know what killed it and how long ago.
abilities.cost: A quarter hour walking the wreck

growth.grows: how old a wreck and how much detail

abilities.name: Suit Patch
abilities.description: You can seal a tear in a pressure suit with tape and sealant in seconds, enough to reach an airlock.
abilities.cost: Uses a patch kit; the seal fails in an hour

growth.grows: how big a tear and how long it holds

abilities.name: Oxygen Miser
abilities.description: You can slow your breathing so your air lasts half again as long as it should.
abilities.cost: Sluggish thinking while you do it

growth.grows: how much longer your air lasts

abilities.name: Salvage Rights Talk
abilities.description: Speak salvage law to a rival crew and they back off a wreck you reached first, unless they are pirates.
abilities.cost: Pirates laugh; the law means nothing to them

growth.grows: how stubborn a rival backs down

abilities.name: Power Coupling Trick
abilities.description: Bridge two dead systems with a cable so one of them runs for a few minutes.
abilities.cost: Sparks and burns; the cable melts

growth.grows: how big a system and how long

abilities.name: Nav Ghost
abilities.description: Read old navigation logs and you can recall a safe route through a debris field once you have seen it.
abilities.cost: Logs older than a year can be wrong

growth.grows: how dense a field you can cross

abilities.name: Drone Buddy
abilities.description: Send your repair drone into a space too small for you and see what it sees for a few minutes.
abilities.cost: The drone needs a recharge after

growth.grows: how far and how long it ranges

abilities.name: Cold Sleep Wake
abilities.description: You can wake from cryosleep fully alert, while others are groggy for an hour.
abilities.cost: You feel every year you slept in your joints

growth.grows: how long a sleep you shrug off

abilities.name: Reactor Ear
abilities.description: Hear a ship's reactor hum and sense whether it is about to fail.
abilities.cost: Only reactors you have stood near for an hour

abilities.name: Void Nerve
abilities.description: Stay calm on a spacewalk when your tether snaps, keeping your head long enough to catch a handhold.
abilities.cost: Shakes for an hour once you are inside

growth.grows: how long you can keep your head
